title: Six AI-powered gadgets that could make your home office smarter
lede: TechCrunch rounds up six AI-equipped products for a home office, from a recording pen and a clip-on recorder to a tracking webcam and a standing desk with activity sensors.

points: Flowtica Scribe ($159) combines a gel pen with an audio recorder, then transcribes meetings, summarizes them and drafts a to-do list; it handles 92 languages.
Anker Soundcore Work ($159) is a coin-sized recording pin with up to eight hours per charge, 300 free transcription minutes a month and optional paid plans.
Logitech MX Keypad ($99) adds dedicated buttons that launch AI assistants and tools including GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.
Kindle Scribe Colorsoft ($629) uses AI to clean up handwriting, straighten highlights, summarize notes and search across them.
Insta360 Link 2 Pro ($249) is a 4K webcam that follows you around the room; Autonomous Desk Pro ($599) tracks sitting time and answers questions about it, including room CO2.
